objective: COA Gate 3A: obtener contrato exacto de tipos de llaves, PK/FK, defaults y convenciones de auditoria necesarias para generar posteriormente el DDL minimo COA sin adivinar tipos ni alterar objetos canonicos. Basarse en el dossier docs/COA/COA_GATE2_CANONICAL_MODEL_DOSSIER.md. No ejecutar DDL/DML/EXEC/SELECT INTO. No hardcodear comisiones: 6.5% es solo una posible regla comercial y nunca un default. Produccion=false.

queries.name: coa_canonical_key_types
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (t.name='Sistema_Empresas' AND c.name='EmpresaID') OR (t.name='Unidades_Negocio' AND c.name='id') OR (t.name='Usuario_Catalogo' AND c.name='UsuarioID') OR (t.name='Cliente_Catalogo' AND c.name='ClienteID') OR (t.name='Proveedor_Catalogo' AND c.name='ProveedorID') OR (t.name='Compras_DocumentosFiscales' AND c.name='DocumentoFiscalID') OR (t.name='Finanzas_Pagos' AND c.name='PagoID') OR (t.name='Finanzas_CxP_DecisionesPago' AND c.name='DecisionPagoID') OR (t.name='RH_Nomina' AND c.name='NominaID') OR (t.name='RH_Nomina_Dispersion' AND c.name='DispersionNominaID') OR (t.name='RH_Nomina_Recibos' AND c.name='NominaReciboID') OR (t.name='RH_Colaboradores_Expediente' AND c.name='ColaboradorID') OR (t.name='CRM_Contratos' AND c.name='ContratoID') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: coa_canonical_pk_constraints
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,kc.name AS pk_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.key_constraints kc ON kc.parent_object_id=t.object_id AND kc.type='PK' JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=t.object_id AND ic.index_id=kc.unique_index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Sistema_Empresas','Unidades_Negocio','Usuario_Catalogo','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Compras_DocumentosFiscales','Finanzas_Pagos','Finanzas_CxP_DecisionesPago','RH_Nomina','RH_Nomina_Dispersion','RH_Nomina_Recibos','RH_Colaboradores_Expediente','CRM_Contratos') ORDER BY t.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: coa_audit_column_patterns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=t.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE t.name IN ('Finanzas_CxP_DecisionesPago','Compras_DocumentosFiscales','CRM_Contratos','Proveedor_Documentos','Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion') AND (c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Creacion%' OR c.name LIKE '%Modificacion%' OR c.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR c.name LIKE '%Activo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estatus%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR c.name LIKE '%Hash%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: coa_candidate_id_generation_patterns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.is_identity,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=t.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE t.name IN ('Finanzas_CxP_DecisionesPago','Compras_DocumentosFiscales','CRM_Contratos','Proveedor_Documentos','Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion','Comercial_CostosMargenesConfiguracion','Comercial_ReglasPrecio') AND c.column_id=1 ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: coa_status_catalog_patterns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Finanzas_EstatusPago','CRM_Cat_EstatusContrato','RH_Cat_EstatusPeriodoNomina') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id
